blocks.source: ファイナルファンタジー13
blocks.translation: Final Fantasy XIII

blocks.source: 質量／物語
blocks.translation: Length / Story

blocks.source: ４０時間程度でクリア。クリア後のやり込みは手付かず。シリーズの中では短いほうだが、それでも正直なところ、内容の割に時間を喰ったと言う印象。
blocks.translation: Cleared in about 40 hours. I haven't touched the post-game content. It's on the shorter side for the series, but even so, honestly, I felt that it took a lot of time considering the amount of content.

blocks.source: 地上世界「パルス」とその上空に浮かぶ世界「コクーン」という、２つの世界を舞台にした物語。発売前の事前情報からは独自用語が多く複雑な印象を受けたが、実際にプレイしたところ、主な独自用語は上記の「パルス」「コクーン」に加えて……
blocks.translation: A story set in two worlds: the ground-level world of "Pulse" and the world of "Cocoon," floating high above it. The advance information before release gave the impression that it was complicated, with many original terms, but after actually playing it, the main original terms, in addition to the aforementioned "Pulse" and "Cocoon," are...

blocks.source: 「ファルシ」：神が作った意思を持った装置の様なもの。
blocks.translation: "Fal'Cie": Devices created by gods that possess a will of their own.

blocks.source: 「ルシ」：ファルシに選ばれた（呪われた？）人間。
blocks.translation: "L'Cie": Humans chosen (or cursed?) by the Fal'Cie.

blocks.source: の４つくらいのものなので、大したことはない。メニューで用語解説、人物解説、物語解説などがいつでも読めるので、わからなければ見直すこともできる。
blocks.translation: There are only about four of these, so it's nothing major. Explanations of terminology, characters, and the story can always be read from the menu, so you can review them if you don't understand something.

blocks.source: ＦＦ１２と異なり、キャラクターの描写は仲間６人ともかなり詳細にされている。反面、自らの心情をわざわざ言葉で語るシーンが多く見られるため、少ししつこい印象も受けた。今までのＦＦだと、言葉にするよりも行動で表すことで、テンポ良く仕上げていたように思う。
blocks.translation: Unlike Final Fantasy XII, all six party members are depicted in considerable detail. On the other hand, there are many scenes where they go out of their way to verbalize their feelings, which made it feel a little repetitive. In previous Final Fantasy games, I felt that expressing things through actions rather than words resulted in a better pace.

blocks.source: 全１３章構成だが、大雑把な僕の印象としては、
blocks.translation: Although the game consists of 13 chapters, my rough impression is that:

blocks.source: １～２章：舞台説明（オープニング）
blocks.translation: Chapters 1–2: Introduction to the setting (opening)

blocks.source: ３～７章：仲間６人がバラバラに行動。各仲間の心情描写、及び過去の出来事の回想。
blocks.translation: Chapters 3–7: The six party members act separately. Depictions of each member's feelings, along with flashbacks to past events.

blocks.source: ８～９章：６人が集合し、ようやく物語が動き出す。
blocks.translation: Chapters 8–9: The six reunite, and the story finally gets moving.

blocks.source: １０～１１章：蛇足。（ゲーム的にはともかく、シナリオ的には大きな意義がない。）
blocks.translation: Chapters 10–11: Superfluous. (Regardless of its significance as a game, it has little significance from a story perspective.)

blocks.source: １２～１３章：ラストダンジョン。
blocks.translation: Chapters 12–13: The final dungeon.

blocks.source: という感じ。
blocks.translation: That's the general idea.

blocks.source: ７章まではどちらかというと前置きと言う印象を受けた。そして、８～９章で仲間が集まり、「ようやく面白くなってきたぞ！」と思ったら、以降、特に大きな展開のないまま、ラストダンジョンに突入して、あっけなく終わってしまう。
blocks.translation: Up through Chapter 7, it felt more like a prelude. Then, when the party members came together in Chapters 8–9, I thought, "It's finally getting interesting!" But from there, without any major developments, they enter the final dungeon and the game ends anticlimactically.

blocks.source: このように物語は世界観に対するこだわりと比較すると、展開に乏しく物足りない。主人公達の目的が何なのかが、はっきりとしない場面が多く、特に終盤の展開は演出の勢いに任せた行き当たりばったりにしか見えなかった。
blocks.translation: Thus, compared with the care given to the setting, the story lacks development and feels unsatisfying. There are many scenes where the protagonists' objective is unclear, and the developments near the end in particular seemed completely improvised, driven only by the momentum of the presentation.

blocks.source: システム
blocks.translation: Systems

blocks.source: 今回の戦闘システムは一応はシリーズおなじみのＡＴＢとなっているが、今までとは大きく異なる。まず、戦闘では時間で溜まったゲージの量に応じて、キャラクターの行動を複数入力できる。その代わりに、操作できるのは戦闘メンバー３人中、リーダ１人だけとなる。
blocks.translation: The battle system this time is, technically, the familiar ATB system from the series, but it differs greatly from previous installments. First, during battle, you can input multiple actions for a character according to how much the gauge has filled over time. In exchange, only one of the three active party members—the leader—can be controlled.

blocks.source: 残り２人のキャラは「ロール」（攻撃、回復、補助などの役割）が変更できるだけで、具体的な行動は指定できない。そのため、補助のロールを持った仲間に「ヘイスト（素早さアップ）を先に使ってくれ！」と思っても、プロテス（防御アップ）を使ってしまうなど、融通が聞かない場合がある。
blocks.translation: For the other two characters, you can only change their "roles" (such as attack, recovery, or support); you cannot specify their exact actions. As a result, even if you think, "Use Haste (increased speed) first!" when asking a party member with a support role to help, they may use Protect (increased defense) instead, making them inflexible.

blocks.source: なお、ロールは個別に変更するのではなく「オプティマ」といって、３人分のロールの組み合わせを６パターン登録しておいて、これを戦闘中に場面に応じて切り替えて行くことになる。
blocks.translation: Also, rather than changing roles individually, you register six patterns of role combinations for the three characters, called "Optima," and switch between them during battle according to the situation.

blocks.source: 戦闘は「システムとしては」非常にスピーディで、敵味方全員の行動が並行して行われる。ただし、その分、乱戦になりすぎて何をやっているかが、わからなくなることも。
blocks.translation: Battles are extremely fast-paced "as a system," with all enemies' and allies' actions taking place simultaneously. However, this can also make the fighting so chaotic that you lose track of what is happening.

blocks.source: ＨＰはサガシリーズのように戦闘終了後は全回復する。ＭＰの概念はなく、魔法などの技能はいくらでも使うことができる。
blocks.translation: HP is fully restored after battle, as in the SaGa series. There is no concept of MP, so magic and other abilities can be used as many times as you like.

blocks.source: 成長システムのクリスタリウムはＦＦＸのスフィア盤によく似ている。上述のロール毎に別れたボード上を進行させながらＣＰ（経験値）を消費して、能力を上げたり、技能を習得して行く。スフィア盤の様な自由度はないが、キャラクターごとの個性も崩れにくい。しかし、自由度がないなら、もっとシンプルにできたのでは……。
blocks.translation: The Crystarium growth system closely resembles Final Fantasy X's Sphere Grid. You move along boards divided by the roles mentioned above, spending CP (experience points) to raise stats and learn abilities. It isn't as flexible as the Sphere Grid, but it also makes it less difficult for each character to retain their individuality. Still, if there is no freedom, couldn't it have been made simpler...?

blocks.source: 今回、１１章を除くといつものＦＦ以上に一本道になっている。買い物ですら、セーブポイントで済ませてしまえる。町は２つほど存在するが何の施設もなし。町人との会話もあってないようなもの。ひたすら、ダンジョンと戦闘とイベントの繰り返しなのでメリハリに欠ける。
blocks.translation: This time, apart from Chapter 11, the game is even more linear than a typical Final Fantasy. You can even do your shopping at save points. There are about two towns, but they have no facilities whatsoever. Conversations with townspeople are practically nonexistent. Since the game consists almost entirely of repeating dungeons, battles, and events, it lacks variety.

blocks.source: バランス
blocks.translation: Balance

blocks.source: ゲームの進行度に応じて、かなり印象が変わる。
blocks.translation: The impression it gives you changes considerably depending on how far you have progressed through the game.

blocks.source: まず、前半は戦闘が非常に単調。特に２章までは使えないシステムが多く、単体攻撃、範囲攻撃と、アイテムによる回復しかすることがない。なんせ、この時点では成長システムすら使えない。
blocks.translation: First, battles in the early half are extremely monotonous. Many systems are unavailable, especially up through Chapter 2, so all you can do is use single-target attacks, area attacks, and items for healing. After all, you can't even use the growth system at this point.

blocks.source: ３章でようやく、「オプティマ」「クリスタリウム」といったシステムが開放される。しかし、しばらくは難易度が低いこともあり、オプティマをたまに変更する以外はさほどやることがない。後は○ボタンを連打しているだけなので、相変わらず退屈極まりない。
blocks.translation: The "Optima" and "Crystarium" systems finally become available in Chapter 3. However, since the difficulty remains low for a while, there isn't much to do apart from occasionally changing Optima. Otherwise, you just mash the ○ button, so it remains incredibly boring.

blocks.source: 操作キャラのコマンドを自動入力してくれる機能が退屈さに拍車をかけている。なんせ、自動入力では敵の弱点なども（判明していれば）自動的に突いてくれる。入力速度が重要なこの戦闘では、コマンド入力より有利な場合が大半となる。
blocks.translation: The feature that automatically inputs commands for the controlled character makes the tedium even worse. With automatic input, it will even automatically target an enemy's weaknesses (if they have been identified). In battles where input speed is important, this is usually more advantageous than entering commands yourself.

blocks.source: しかも、パーティはシナリオ進行に応じてコロコロ変わるため、自分で好きなキャラを選んで編成することすらできない。特に２人パーティの期間が長いけれど、それではシステムの良さを発揮できない。
blocks.translation: Moreover, because the party changes constantly as the story progresses, you can't even choose and organize the characters you like. The period with a two-person party is particularly long, but that prevents the system from showing its strengths.

blocks.source: ９章の途中で仲間６人が集合し、オプティマ構成の自由度が飛躍的に上昇する。この頃には、敵も強くなってくるため、オプティマ構成などの戦闘下準備が重要になる他、戦闘中に素早く適切なオプティマに切り替える判断力が重要になってくる。
blocks.translation: The six party members reunite midway through Chapter 9, dramatically increasing the freedom of your Optima configurations. By this point, the enemies have also grown stronger, making battle preparations such as configuring Optima important, as well as the ability to quickly judge and switch to the appropriate Optima during battle.

blocks.source: 難易度としては、過去のＦＦ（４以降）ではありえないほど、全滅が多く難しい。まるで、メガテンシリーズのごとく、リーダのＨＰが０になると全滅になるので油断できない。その代わり、戦闘で全滅しても戦闘直前からやり直すことができるし、戦闘中にもいつでもやり直しできる。
blocks.translation: In terms of difficulty, it is so hard and results in so many party wipes that it would have been unthinkable in previous Final Fantasy games (IV onward). Like in the Shin Megami Tensei series, the entire party is wiped out when the leader's HP reaches 0, so you can't let your guard down. In exchange, even if you are wiped out in battle, you can restart from just before the battle, and you can also retry at any time during battle.

blocks.source: で「面白くなってきた！」と思ったら、今度は敵（ザコ・ボス共に）のＨＰが無駄に多くなってきて、戦闘に時間がかかる様になってくる。（本当に無駄に多い。ＨＰは半分以下でいいのではと思うこと多々……）
blocks.translation: Just when you think, "It's getting interesting!" the enemies' HP (both regular enemies and bosses) starts becoming pointlessly high, making battles take longer. (It really is excessive. I often found myself thinking their HP could have been less than half...)

blocks.source: なんせ、ＭＰがないわけだから、慎重に回復をするような戦い方をすると、延々と時間だけが過ぎていく。この傾向は最後までどんどん酷くなる。
blocks.translation: Since there is no MP, if you fight cautiously and heal carefully, time simply drags on endlessly. This tendency only gets worse as you approach the end.

blocks.source: １１章では大きなマップに出るため自由度が上がる。この頃が、ゲーム性という面ではこのゲームの最盛期だと思う。１２～１３章で結局エンディングまで一本道になるけど……。
blocks.translation: In Chapter 11, you enter a large map, which increases your freedom. I think this is the game's peak in terms of gameplay. Chapters 12–13 ultimately become linear again all the way to the ending, though...

blocks.source: 快適性
blocks.translation: Comfort

blocks.source: ロード時間については、ほとんど問題ない。ＨＤＤインストールなしで、この速度は脅威的。また、ムービーについてもスキップ機能が完備されている。
blocks.translation: Loading times are hardly a problem. This speed is impressive without installing the game to the HDD. The movies also come with a complete skip feature.

blocks.source: しかし、戦闘が非常に面倒臭いのは致命的。上述した内容と重なるけれど……
blocks.translation: However, the fact that battles are extremely tedious is fatal. This overlaps with what I mentioned above, but...

blocks.source: 無駄に多い後半の敵のＨＰ
blocks.translation: The pointlessly high HP of enemies in the latter half

blocks.source: 合わせて、回復魔法に制限が無く、いつまでも長引く戦闘。
blocks.translation: In addition, battles can drag on indefinitely because there are no restrictions on healing magic.

blocks.source: シンボルエンカウントだが、狭い道で避けにくい。
blocks.translation: Although it uses symbol encounters, they are difficult to avoid on narrow paths.

blocks.source: 町などの寄り道要素が乏しく、戦闘がゲームに占める割合が大きい。
blocks.translation: There are few side activities, such as towns, so battles make up a large portion of the game.

blocks.source: また、成長システムの「クリスタリウム」だが、能力アップを行うたびにある演出がわずらわしい。見た目も無駄に立体構造になっており見辛い。
blocks.translation: Also, the growth system, the “Crystarium,” has an annoying presentation that plays every time you upgrade an ability. Its appearance is needlessly three-dimensional as well, making it difficult to see.

blocks.source: 美術
blocks.translation: Art

blocks.source: これについては、紛れもなく期待通り。１２章開始時のムービー画面なんて、これでもかというほど魅せてくれる。通常のゲーム画面のグラフィックが向上したのに伴い、ムービー画面との差異もあまり気にならない。
blocks.translation: In this respect, it was unquestionably as expected. The movie scene at the beginning of Chapter 12 is especially spectacular. As the graphics in the regular game screen have improved, the difference between them and the movie scenes is not particularly noticeable either.

blocks.source: １１章の広大なマップをのし歩く巨大モンスターの描写は非常にわくわくさせてくれるものがあった。
blocks.translation: The depiction of giant monsters lumbering across the vast map in Chapter 11 was incredibly exciting.

blocks.source: 音楽
blocks.translation: Music

blocks.source: これも美術と並んで大方、期待通り。サガフロンティア２やアンリミテッドサガの他、ＦＦＸで一部の作曲を担当した浜渦正志氏が全曲を担当している。バイオリンが美しい通常戦闘曲は、発売前から既に話題だった。
blocks.translation: For the most part, this was also as expected, alongside the art. Masashi Hamauzu, who composed all the music, had previously worked on SaGa Frontier 2 and Unlimited SaGa, as well as composing some of the music for FFX. The regular battle theme, with its beautiful violin, had already become a topic of discussion before release.

blocks.source: 全体的な雰囲気としては、ＦＦ１２と同様に背景であることを意識してか、印象に残る曲はやや少なめ。ただＦＦ１２と比較すると、所々で印象的なメロディが使われている。今までの浜渦氏の曲の印象と違い激しい曲やオーケストラっぽい曲が多いのは意外だった。
blocks.translation: In terms of the overall atmosphere, there are somewhat few memorable songs, perhaps because, like FFXII, the music was consciously intended to serve as background. However, compared with FFXII, memorable melodies are used here and there. Unlike the impression left by Hamauzu’s music up to that point, I was surprised by how many intense and orchestral-sounding pieces there were.

blocks.source: あえて不満点を上げると、通常戦闘曲は素晴らしいのだが、それ以外に印象に残った戦闘曲がなかった。特にラストバトルの曲は色々盛り込もうとしすぎて、返って印象が薄くなっているような……。
blocks.translation: If I had to point out a complaint, the regular battle theme is wonderful, but there were no other battle themes that left an impression. In particular, the final battle theme seems to have become less memorable because it tried too hard to incorporate a little of everything…

blocks.source: まとめ
blocks.translation: Summary

blocks.source: 「町を廃止」「ＭＰを廃止」「仲間のコマンド入力を廃止」といった既存のゲームシステムから脱却した点がどうにもこうにも、作品をメリハリがなく単調なものにしている。これらに代わる要素が十分ならよかったけれど物足りない。
blocks.translation: The departure from established game systems, such as “abolishing towns,” “abolishing MP,” and “abolishing command input for party members,” somehow or other makes the game bland and monotonous, without enough variation. It would have been fine if there had been sufficient replacement elements, but there simply are not enough.

blocks.source: 以前のＦＦ（特に８、９）ではグラフィックを見せつけたいがために、戦闘テンポが犠牲になっている箇所が見られたが、ＦＦ１３ではシステム的に各キャラクターの動作を並行して処理することによって、こういった問題はない。
blocks.translation: In earlier FF games (especially VIII and IX), there were times when the battle tempo was sacrificed in order to show off the graphics. In FFXIII, however, the system processes each character’s actions in parallel, so it does not have these problems.

blocks.source: ……が、敵のＨＰが無駄に多すぎることによって、大幅にテンポが悪化し、せっかくの技術力の高さが台なしになっている。
blocks.translation: …However, the excessive amount of HP given to the enemies severely worsens the tempo, completely undermining the impressive technical achievement.

blocks.source: 「新しいシステムがどうしてもうまく行かない」とか、「シナリオと演出を見せたいばかりに一本道になる」とか、そういった問題については多少は仕方ないとは思う。しかし、１３作目にしてこんな調整不足とはもったいない限り。
blocks.translation: I think problems such as “the new system just doesn’t work properly” and “the game becomes linear simply because it wants to showcase the scenario and presentation” are somewhat unavoidable. However, it is truly a waste that, even by the thirteenth installment, the game could be so lacking in balance adjustments.

blocks.source: 難解と呼ばれるＦＦ１３のストーリーをまとめてみました。
blocks.translation: I’ve put together a summary of the story of FFXIII, which is often called difficult to understand.

blocks.source: ※エンディングも含むのでネタバレ注意です！
blocks.translation: ※This includes the ending, so beware of spoilers!

blocks.source: コクーンに住む主人公達は成り行きで、パルスのファルシのルシになってしまった！
blocks.translation: The protagonists living in Cocoon ended up becoming l'Cie of Pulse's fal'Cie!

blocks.source: ①コクーン聖府
blocks.translation: ①Cocoon Sanctum

blocks.source: 「ルシはコクーンに害を成すから殺す！」
blocks.translation: ""We have to kill the l'Cie because they threaten Cocoon!"

blocks.source: ②主人公
blocks.translation: ②Protagonist

blocks.source: 「殺されるのは嫌だ、聖府を倒す！」
blocks.translation: ""I don't want to be killed. We'll defeat the Sanctum!"

blocks.source: ③聖府代表
blocks.translation: ③Sanctum Representative

blocks.source: 「ルシを殺すと言ったのはウソだ。
blocks.translation: "I lied when I said I would kill the l'Cie.

blocks.source: むしろ儀式のためにコクーンを滅ぼしてくれ。
blocks.translation: In fact, I want you to destroy Cocoon for the ritual.

blocks.source: 拒否するならルシの呪いで酷いことになるよ」
blocks.translation: If you refuse, the l'Cie's curse will make things terrible for you.   "

blocks.source: ④主人公
blocks.translation: ④Protagonist

blocks.source: 「えっ、それは嫌だ」
blocks.translation: ""Huh? I don't want to do that."

blocks.source: ⑤聖府代表
blocks.translation: ⑤Sanctum Representative

blocks.source: 「お前達に選択肢はない。
blocks.translation: "You have no choice.

blocks.source: 飛空艇で遺跡に送ってやるから現実を見ろ」
blocks.translation: I'll send you to the ruins by airship, so see the truth for yourselves."

blocks.source: ⑥主人公
blocks.translation: ⑥Protagonist

blocks.source: 「遺跡を探索していたら、別の飛空艇を見つけたぞ！
blocks.translation: "We found another airship while exploring the ruins!

blocks.source: これで下界へ降りれば何とかなるかも！」
blocks.translation: Maybe we can make it down to the Underworld with this!"

blocks.source: ↓（１０時間経過）
blocks.translation: ↓ (10Time passes)

blocks.source: ⑦主人公
blocks.translation: ⑦Protagonist

blocks.source: 「下界を探索したけど特に何もなかったよ……」
blocks.translation: "We explored the Underworld, but there was nothing in particular there......"

blocks.source: ⑧聖府代表
blocks.translation: ⑧Sanctum Representative

blocks.source: 「だから、言ったじゃん。
blocks.translation: "That's what I told you.

blocks.source: それじゃあ、帰りの飛空艇を用意したから、
blocks.translation: Well then, I've prepared an airship for your return, so

blocks.source: 今度こそコクーンを滅ぼしてくれ」
blocks.translation: this time, destroy Cocoon for sure."

blocks.source: ⑨主人公
blocks.translation: ⑨Protagonist

blocks.source: 「こうなったらコクーンに戻って聖府代表を倒す！」
blocks.translation: "Since it has come to this, we'll return to Cocoon and defeat the Sanctum Representative!"

blocks.source: ⑩主人公
blocks.translation: ⑩Protagonist

blocks.source: 「聖府代表を倒したら、巻き添えでコクーンも滅んじゃった。
blocks.translation: "After defeating the Sanctum Representative, Cocoon was destroyed along with him.

blocks.source: でも、なんか奇跡が起きて住民は助かったよ！
blocks.translation: But then, somehow, a miracle occurred and the residents were saved!

blocks.source: めでたしめでたし」
blocks.translation: And they all lived happily ever after."

blocks.source: ……色々とツッコミどころはありますが、一番は「敵が用意してくれた飛空艇にその場のノリで乗り込む展開」が３回もあることだと思います。
blocks.translation: …There are plenty of things to question, but I think the biggest one is that there are three separate occasions when the characters board an airship prepared by the enemy on the spur of the moment.

texts.４０時間程度でクリア。クリア後のやり込みは手付かず。シリーズの中では短いほうだが: Cleared in about 40 hours. I haven't touched the post-game content. It's on the shorter side for the series, but even so, honestly, I felt that it took a lot of time considering the amount of content.
texts.地上世界「パルス」とその上空に浮かぶ世界「コクーン」という、２つの世界を舞台にし: A story set in two worlds: the ground-level world of "Pulse" and the world of "Cocoon," floating high above it. The advance information before release gave the impression that it was complicated, with many original terms, but after actually playing it, the main original terms, in addition to the aforementioned "Pulse" and "Cocoon," are...
texts.「ファルシ」：神が作った意思を持った装置の様なもの。: "Fal'Cie": Devices created by gods that possess a will of their own.
texts.「ルシ」：ファルシに選ばれた（呪われた？）人間。: "L'Cie": Humans chosen (or cursed?) by the Fal'Cie.
texts.の４つくらいのものなので、大したことはない。メニューで用語解説、人物解説、物語解: There are only about four of these, so it's nothing major. Explanations of terminology, characters, and the story can always be read from the menu, so you can review them if you don't understand something.
texts.ＦＦ１２と異なり、キャラクターの描写は仲間６人ともかなり詳細にされている。反面、: Unlike Final Fantasy XII, all six party members are depicted in considerable detail. On the other hand, there are many scenes where they go out of their way to verbalize their feelings, which made it feel a little repetitive. In previous Final Fantasy games, I felt that expressing things through actions rather than words resulted in a better pace.
texts.全１３章構成だが、大雑把な僕の印象としては、: Although the game consists of 13 chapters, my rough impression is that:
texts.３～７章：仲間６人がバラバラに行動。各仲間の心情描写、及び過去の出来事の回想。: Chapters 3–7: The six party members act separately. Depictions of each member's feelings, along with flashbacks to past events.
texts.８～９章：６人が集合し、ようやく物語が動き出す。: Chapters 8–9: The six reunite, and the story finally gets moving.
texts.１０～１１章：蛇足。（ゲーム的にはともかく、シナリオ的には大きな意義がない。）: Chapters 10–11: Superfluous. (Regardless of its significance as a game, it has little significance from a story perspective.)
texts.７章まではどちらかというと前置きと言う印象を受けた。そして、８～９章で仲間が集ま: Up through Chapter 7, it felt more like a prelude. Then, when the party members came together in Chapters 8–9, I thought, "It's finally getting interesting!" But from there, without any major developments, they enter the final dungeon and the game ends anticlimactically.
texts.このように物語は世界観に対するこだわりと比較すると、展開に乏しく物足りない。主人: Thus, compared with the care given to the setting, the story lacks development and feels unsatisfying. There are many scenes where the protagonists' objective is unclear, and the developments near the end in particular seemed completely improvised, driven only by the momentum of the presentation.
texts.今回の戦闘システムは一応はシリーズおなじみのＡＴＢとなっているが、今までとは大き: The battle system this time is, technically, the familiar ATB system from the series, but it differs greatly from previous installments. First, during battle, you can input multiple actions for a character according to how much the gauge has filled over time. In exchange, only one of the three active party members—the leader—can be controlled.
texts.残り２人のキャラは「ロール」（攻撃、回復、補助などの役割）が変更できるだけで、具: For the other two characters, you can only change their "roles" (such as attack, recovery, or support); you cannot specify their exact actions. As a result, even if you think, "Use Haste (increased speed) first!" when asking a party member with a support role to help, they may use Protect (increased defense) instead, making them inflexible.
texts.なお、ロールは個別に変更するのではなく「オプティマ」といって、３人分のロールの組: Also, rather than changing roles individually, you register six patterns of role combinations for the three characters, called "Optima," and switch between them during battle according to the situation.
texts.戦闘は「システムとしては」非常にスピーディで、敵味方全員の行動が並行して行われる: Battles are extremely fast-paced "as a system," with all enemies' and allies' actions taking place simultaneously. However, this can also make the fighting so chaotic that you lose track of what is happening.
texts.ＨＰはサガシリーズのように戦闘終了後は全回復する。ＭＰの概念はなく、魔法などの技: HP is fully restored after battle, as in the SaGa series. There is no concept of MP, so magic and other abilities can be used as many times as you like.
texts.成長システムのクリスタリウムはＦＦＸのスフィア盤によく似ている。上述のロール毎に: The Crystarium growth system closely resembles Final Fantasy X's Sphere Grid. You move along boards divided by the roles mentioned above, spending CP (experience points) to raise stats and learn abilities. It isn't as flexible as the Sphere Grid, but it also makes it less difficult for each character to retain their individuality. Still, if there is no freedom, couldn't it have been made simpler...?
texts.今回、１１章を除くといつものＦＦ以上に一本道になっている。買い物ですら、セーブポ: This time, apart from Chapter 11, the game is even more linear than a typical Final Fantasy. You can even do your shopping at save points. There are about two towns, but they have no facilities whatsoever. Conversations with townspeople are practically nonexistent. Since the game consists almost entirely of repeating dungeons, battles, and events, it lacks variety.
texts.ゲームの進行度に応じて、かなり印象が変わる。: The impression it gives you changes considerably depending on how far you have progressed through the game.
texts.まず、前半は戦闘が非常に単調。特に２章までは使えないシステムが多く、単体攻撃、範: First, battles in the early half are extremely monotonous. Many systems are unavailable, especially up through Chapter 2, so all you can do is use single-target attacks, area attacks, and items for healing. After all, you can't even use the growth system at this point.
texts.３章でようやく、「オプティマ」「クリスタリウム」といったシステムが開放される。し: The "Optima" and "Crystarium" systems finally become available in Chapter 3. However, since the difficulty remains low for a while, there isn't much to do apart from occasionally changing Optima. Otherwise, you just mash the ○ button, so it remains incredibly boring.
texts.操作キャラのコマンドを自動入力してくれる機能が退屈さに拍車をかけている。なんせ、: The feature that automatically inputs commands for the controlled character makes the tedium even worse. With automatic input, it will even automatically target an enemy's weaknesses (if they have been identified). In battles where input speed is important, this is usually more advantageous than entering commands yourself.
texts.しかも、パーティはシナリオ進行に応じてコロコロ変わるため、自分で好きなキャラを選: Moreover, because the party changes constantly as the story progresses, you can't even choose and organize the characters you like. The period with a two-person party is particularly long, but that prevents the system from showing its strengths.
texts.９章の途中で仲間６人が集合し、オプティマ構成の自由度が飛躍的に上昇する。この頃に: The six party members reunite midway through Chapter 9, dramatically increasing the freedom of your Optima configurations. By this point, the enemies have also grown stronger, making battle preparations such as configuring Optima important, as well as the ability to quickly judge and switch to the appropriate Optima during battle.
texts.難易度としては、過去のＦＦ（４以降）ではありえないほど、全滅が多く難しい。まるで: In terms of difficulty, it is so hard and results in so many party wipes that it would have been unthinkable in previous Final Fantasy games (IV onward). Like in the Shin Megami Tensei series, the entire party is wiped out when the leader's HP reaches 0, so you can't let your guard down. In exchange, even if you are wiped out in battle, you can restart from just before the battle, and you can also retry at any time during battle.
texts.で「面白くなってきた！」と思ったら、今度は敵（ザコ・ボス共に）のＨＰが無駄に多く: Just when you think, "It's getting interesting!" the enemies' HP (both regular enemies and bosses) starts becoming pointlessly high, making battles take longer. (It really is excessive. I often found myself thinking their HP could have been less than half...)
texts.なんせ、ＭＰがないわけだから、慎重に回復をするような戦い方をすると、延々と時間だ: Since there is no MP, if you fight cautiously and heal carefully, time simply drags on endlessly. This tendency only gets worse as you approach the end.
texts.１１章では大きなマップに出るため自由度が上がる。この頃が、ゲーム性という面ではこ: In Chapter 11, you enter a large map, which increases your freedom. I think this is the game's peak in terms of gameplay. Chapters 12–13 ultimately become linear again all the way to the ending, though...
texts.ロード時間については、ほとんど問題ない。ＨＤＤインストールなしで、この速度は脅威: Loading times are hardly a problem. This speed is impressive without installing the game to the HDD. The movies also come with a complete skip feature.
texts.しかし、戦闘が非常に面倒臭いのは致命的。上述した内容と重なるけれど……: However, the fact that battles are extremely tedious is fatal. This overlaps with what I mentioned above, but...
texts.無駄に多い後半の敵のＨＰ: The pointlessly high HP of enemies in the latter half
texts.合わせて、回復魔法に制限が無く、いつまでも長引く戦闘。: In addition, battles can drag on indefinitely because there are no restrictions on healing magic.
texts.シンボルエンカウントだが、狭い道で避けにくい。: Although it uses symbol encounters, they are difficult to avoid on narrow paths.
texts.町などの寄り道要素が乏しく、戦闘がゲームに占める割合が大きい。: There are few side activities, such as towns, so battles make up a large portion of the game.
texts.また、成長システムの「クリスタリウム」だが、能力アップを行うたびにある演出がわず: Also, the growth system, the “Crystarium,” has an annoying presentation that plays every time you upgrade an ability. Its appearance is needlessly three-dimensional as well, making it difficult to see.
texts.これについては、紛れもなく期待通り。１２章開始時のムービー画面なんて、これでもか: In this respect, it was unquestionably as expected. The movie scene at the beginning of Chapter 12 is especially spectacular. As the graphics in the regular game screen have improved, the difference between them and the movie scenes is not particularly noticeable either.
texts.１１章の広大なマップをのし歩く巨大モンスターの描写は非常にわくわくさせてくれるも: The depiction of giant monsters lumbering across the vast map in Chapter 11 was incredibly exciting.
texts.これも美術と並んで大方、期待通り。サガフロンティア２やアンリミテッドサガの他、Ｆ: For the most part, this was also as expected, alongside the art. Masashi Hamauzu, who composed all the music, had previously worked on SaGa Frontier 2 and Unlimited SaGa, as well as composing some of the music for FFX. The regular battle theme, with its beautiful violin, had already become a topic of discussion before release.
texts.全体的な雰囲気としては、ＦＦ１２と同様に背景であることを意識してか、印象に残る曲: In terms of the overall atmosphere, there are somewhat few memorable songs, perhaps because, like FFXII, the music was consciously intended to serve as background. However, compared with FFXII, memorable melodies are used here and there. Unlike the impression left by Hamauzu’s music up to that point, I was surprised by how many intense and orchestral-sounding pieces there were.
texts.あえて不満点を上げると、通常戦闘曲は素晴らしいのだが、それ以外に印象に残った戦闘: If I had to point out a complaint, the regular battle theme is wonderful, but there were no other battle themes that left an impression. In particular, the final battle theme seems to have become less memorable because it tried too hard to incorporate a little of everything…
texts.「町を廃止」「ＭＰを廃止」「仲間のコマンド入力を廃止」といった既存のゲームシステ: The departure from established game systems, such as “abolishing towns,” “abolishing MP,” and “abolishing command input for party members,” somehow or other makes the game bland and monotonous, without enough variation. It would have been fine if there had been sufficient replacement elements, but there simply are not enough.
texts.以前のＦＦ（特に８、９）ではグラフィックを見せつけたいがために、戦闘テンポが犠牲: In earlier FF games (especially VIII and IX), there were times when the battle tempo was sacrificed in order to show off the graphics. In FFXIII, however, the system processes each character’s actions in parallel, so it does not have these problems.
texts.……が、敵のＨＰが無駄に多すぎることによって、大幅にテンポが悪化し、せっかくの技: …However, the excessive amount of HP given to the enemies severely worsens the tempo, completely undermining the impressive technical achievement.
texts.「新しいシステムがどうしてもうまく行かない」とか、「シナリオと演出を見せたいばか: I think problems such as “the new system just doesn’t work properly” and “the game becomes linear simply because it wants to showcase the scenario and presentation” are somewhat unavoidable. However, it is truly a waste that, even by the thirteenth installment, the game could be so lacking in balance adjustments.
texts.難解と呼ばれるＦＦ１３のストーリーをまとめてみました。: I’ve put together a summary of the story of FFXIII, which is often called difficult to understand.
texts.※エンディングも含むのでネタバレ注意です！: ※This includes the ending, so beware of spoilers!
texts.コクーンに住む主人公達は成り行きで、パルスのファルシのルシになってしまった！: The protagonists living in Cocoon ended up becoming l'Cie of Pulse's fal'Cie!
texts.「ルシはコクーンに害を成すから殺す！」: ""We have to kill the l'Cie because they threaten Cocoon!"
texts.「殺されるのは嫌だ、聖府を倒す！」: ""I don't want to be killed. We'll defeat the Sanctum!"
texts.「ルシを殺すと言ったのはウソだ。: "I lied when I said I would kill the l'Cie.
texts.むしろ儀式のためにコクーンを滅ぼしてくれ。: In fact, I want you to destroy Cocoon for the ritual.
texts.拒否するならルシの呪いで酷いことになるよ」: If you refuse, the l'Cie's curse will make things terrible for you.   "
texts.「えっ、それは嫌だ」: ""Huh? I don't want to do that."
texts.飛空艇で遺跡に送ってやるから現実を見ろ」: I'll send you to the ruins by airship, so see the truth for yourselves."
texts.「遺跡を探索していたら、別の飛空艇を見つけたぞ！: "We found another airship while exploring the ruins!
texts.これで下界へ降りれば何とかなるかも！」: Maybe we can make it down to the Underworld with this!"
texts.「下界を探索したけど特に何もなかったよ……」: "We explored the Underworld, but there was nothing in particular there......"
texts.それじゃあ、帰りの飛空艇を用意したから、: Well then, I've prepared an airship for your return, so
texts.今度こそコクーンを滅ぼしてくれ」: this time, destroy Cocoon for sure."
texts.「こうなったらコクーンに戻って聖府代表を倒す！」: "Since it has come to this, we'll return to Cocoon and defeat the Sanctum Representative!"
texts.「聖府代表を倒したら、巻き添えでコクーンも滅んじゃった。: "After defeating the Sanctum Representative, Cocoon was destroyed along with him.
texts.でも、なんか奇跡が起きて住民は助かったよ！: But then, somehow, a miracle occurred and the residents were saved!
texts.めでたしめでたし」: And they all lived happily ever after."
texts.……色々とツッコミどころはありますが、一番は「敵が用意してくれた飛空艇にその場の: …There are plenty of things to question, but I think the biggest one is that there are three separate occasions when the characters board an airship prepared by the enemy on the spur of the moment.
